message: My daughter is 3 years old. Since last night she has fever and now she had a fit, her whole body was shaking for about 2 minutes. She is very sleepy now and not waking up properly.
Baby boy 5 months, fever for 2 days, not taking breast milk since this morning, very sleepy, the soft spot on his head looks raised.
My son is 4 years old. Cough and runny nose for 3 days, mild fever, he is playing and eating normally.
Child 2 years old, loose motions since 2 days, 6 times today, eyes look sunken, very thirsty and drinks eagerly, skin goes back slowly when pinched.
Newborn 6 days old, has not fed since yesterday, body feels cold, moving very little.
Baby 3 weeks old, eyes and skin yellow since 2 days, feeding well, passing urine normally.
My son is 1 year old, cough for 4 days, now breathing very fast and his lower chest goes in with every breath.
Girl 6 years, fever 3 days, red eyes, cough, runny nose, and a rash started behind the ears and spread to face and body.
Baby is vomiting everything and has fever
mera beta 2 saal ka hai, kal raat se bukhar hai aur ab usko jhatke aa rahe hain, aankhein upar chadh gayi hain
naa kuthuru 8 nelalu, moodu rojula nunchi jwaram undi, paalu tagadam ledu, chala nidrapothundi
Boy 10 years fell from a bicycle and hit his head, vomited twice, now very drowsy and says his head hurts a lot.
My 18 month old child drank something from a bottle on the floor, maybe kerosene, and is coughing now.
Child 7 years, sore throat for 2 days, mild fever, eating fine, went to school today.
Baby girl 4 months, very thin, both feet are swollen, not gaining weight, hair is thin and reddish.
Boy 9 years, pain in right lower side of stomach since morning, vomited once, has fever, pain gets worse when he walks.
Baby born yesterday looks yellow all over including the legs, started in the first day.
My 5 year old spilled hot water on his arm. Blisters, about the size of his palm, he is crying but otherwise fine.
Boy 3 years had one loose stool today, drinking normally, playing, no fever.
baby not breathing properly
